name: Karla Trujillo De La Fuente
headline: Empowering World Class Orgs🏆 @Salesforce💙
about:
Mexico has the opportunity to become one of the most influential technology and innovation hubs worldwide. I’m passionate about working with the companies and leaders who want to make that happen. 🌎✨

I help organizations turn AI, data, and digital platforms into real competitive advantage—not just ideas or buzzwords, but measurable business outcomes. 📈

Through the ecosystem of Salesforce, including the next generation of AI innovation like Agentforce, I partner with companies to strengthen data quality, unlock powerful business insights, and implement AI-powered agents that enable smarter workflows, faster decisions, and more meaningful customer experiences. 📊🤖

In a market flooded with new technologies, my role is to act as a trusted advisor—helping leaders cut through the noise, understand where AI can truly create value, and implement solutions that drive growth, efficiency, and transformation. 🚀

I believe the organizations that will lead the next decade are the ones that treat data as a strategic asset and AI as a tool to empower the workforce.

If you’re exploring how AI agents, trusted data, and technology can help your organization scale and lead in the digital era, let’s connect. 🤝
